jordan (pm): Quick sync on the model-entry roadmap. Need final language for acceptance gates, pin lanes, and migration obligations. 48h for comments?

maya (eng): OK. Suggest minimal perf baseline + reproducible benchmark kit. Keep regression threshold tight.

kevin (eng-plat): Infra asks: each catalog entry must include quant profile, estimated GPU mem, and a canary job config. Canary should run on reserved pool for 48h.

sarah (cs): From CS: customers expect a clear migration playbook and opt-in credits for enterprise migrations. Also want pin TTLs surfaced in the console.

lina (legal): Recommend two-lane contract language. Enterprise pins: 90-day grace, dispute SLA in annex. Self-serve pins: shorter TTL but simpler terms. Avoid permanent pin promises.

jordan (pm): Draft proposal: two lanes 1) Self-serve pin (30d TTL, no migration credits, basic SLA) 2) Enterprise pin (90d TTL, migration credits, comms + rollback runbook). Deliverables before GA: bench report, runbook, legal clauses, CS comms, infra canary + dashboard.

maya (eng): Eng will own the runbook and bench harness. I'll add sample prompt slices and a tiny script to replay traces.

kevin (eng-plat): Infra will own canary orchestration + dashboard. We need trace-id propagation and a KV eviction metric in the dashboard. Proposed thresholds: error-rate <0.5%, cold-start p95 <200ms.

sarah (cs): We'll draft the customer-facing migration notice and credit template. Confirming migrations are opt-in for pinned customers? We prefer opt-in.

lina (legal): Opt-in aligns with contracting. We'll add a clause for emergency interrupt (security bug) that shortens TTL with notice.

jordan (pm): If no objections in 48h I'll lock the scope. Owners: @maya (runbook), @kevin (canary+dash), @lina (contract language), @sarah (customer comms).

ops-bot: "roadmap-epic" PR created by @jordan 1 comments requested. CI passed. :white_check_mark:

jordan (pm): Acceptance checklist (to be finalized):
- Bench: p50 & p95 targets, quality regression <=5% on sampled prompts
- Canary: 48h pass, error-rate <0.5%, KV eviction within expected window
- Docs: runbook + migration playbook + CS comms template
- Legal: two-lane pin language + DPA language for Private deployments
- Infra: canary job template + dashboard with trace-id and eviction metrics

maya (eng): I'll post a short PR with the bench harness and a sample eval slice by tomorrow.

kevin (eng-plat): Will add a canary job template and dashboard stub. Need someone to confirm allowed resource sizes for enterprise lane.

sarah (cs): Adding beta customers for a preview next week to validate the rollback flow.

jordan (pm): Thanks. Locking owners now unless you object.
